responsibility: Declares the LTRANS file-cache abstraction used by GCC’s LTO subsystem to manage reusable cached input/output artifact pairs. The header defines checksum_t, the ltrans_file_cache::item record that binds an input file, output file, input checksum, last-used counter, and per-item lockfile, and the public operations for loading/saving cache metadata, inserting a file into the cache, querying cached inputs, opportunistic pruning, and cleanup, along with the creation/deletion lockfiles that govern concurrent access. It is the interface and data-model boundary for the cache implementation in lto-ltrans-cache.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ltrans_file_cache API, item data model, lockfile members, and cache state used by the LTO LTRANS cache. Unlike gcc/lto-ltrans-cache.cc, it does not implement checksuming, file comparison, metadata I/O, naming, or pruning; it serves as the interface/structure definition consumed by that implementation.
